Below the boughs of Gaea's heart, where the goddess finally lay, in the lap of her lover, subdued in all her rage. Sat Sha'fu, warrior of the Med'ja-Hom, reborn in all his splender.

An old Hag of the Shryke shuffled into the temple. Devastation, the aftermath of a small personal war covered the temples floor. Signs of struggle led the Hag to Gaea's Heart, where he found a very content, and very healthy Sha'fu.

As Sha'fu slept beneath the tree, the Hag shuffled closer. Slowly he drew nearer, until his milky eyes where level with Sha'fu's. 'Don't move' said Sha'fu, 'unless you want to draw your last breath'. 'Be calm my young friend, I have been sent to help'. Said the Hag. 'You can help Hag, by stepping away' growled Sha'fu, as he held his blade to the Hags neck.

'Very well', gulped the Hag, as he slowly pulled away from Sha'fu. 'I have come bearing grave news Sha'fu' he said. 'How do you know my name? How did you find me?' Said Sha'fu rising from the base of the tree. 'Start talking now Hag! Before I run you through.'

'I told you, I come bearing grave news' leered the Hag, 'we have a mutual friend, the goddess Zille is need of your aid. How else would I know where to find you. Alone in the forest, only a god could bring me here. A war looms between the gods Sha'fu, Zille needs your aid, will you help her? Will you bring the fruit from the Heart of Gaea to her? Where the land meets the ocean'?

Sha'fu looked at the Hag with astonishment. 'Why would she send you? If she needed my help, why would she not just ask'? The Hag looked at Sha'fu, with a sincerity that that took Sha'fu aback, he said 'it's no longer safe, that she sends me belies her need. Help her Sha'fu, help her.'

With that Sha'fu gave his answer.
